method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_calculators
tools.title: Search MonsiTools calculators
tools.description: Find MonsiTools calculators by keyword (for example 'runway', 'break even', 'roas', 'loan payment'). Returns each match's slug, name, category and input names. Use describe_calculator for details, then calculate to run one.

query.description: Words to match against calculator names, categories and input names.

category.description: Optional exact category name, e.g. 'SaaS Metrics'.

tools.name: describe_calculator
tools.title: Describe a calculator
tools.description: Returns a calculator's name, category, formula, input names and page URL, given its slug.

tools.name: calculate
tools.title: Run a calculator
tools.description: Runs a MonsiTools calculator on the given inputs and returns the result. Works without a key for 10 calculations a day per IP address. A MonsiTools Premium API key, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer mt_live_...' when connecting, removes the daily limit.

inputs.description: Input name to number, for every input the calculator lists.
